name: Herm's Giant Buttermilk Pancakes with Pure Maple Syrup
whyItWorks: Herm's famous plate-sized pancakes made from sifted flour deliver smooth, easily broken-down carbohydrates. Zero rough fiber or irritating seeds make this comforting breakfast very gentle on sensitive intestines.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order with real pure maple syrup. Eat half or share due to the generous portion size, and ask for butter on the side.
